verdict.rationale: Namecheap's own Go SDK documents a `CheckWithContext` call that checks availability of one or more domains. Its XML API endpoints, including a sandbox, are live, as their 'Parameter APIUser is missing' responses show, so programmatic availability checks are a first-party capability. However, the pack has no documentation of rate limits and no first-party reference for the underlying check endpoint beyond the SDK table. Missing for 10: documented rate limits/quotas, full API reference for the domain check command, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check domain availability programmatically — a documented check/search API my code or agent can call with clear rate limits
